name: emem
description: Verifiable shared memory for AI agents: resolve a place to one canonical address, recall Ed25519-signed Earth-observation facts, and hand another agent a token it can check offline.

interface.shortDescription: Signed Earth facts and shared memory that another agent can verify offline.
interface.longDescription: emem gives every place one address (a cell64) and every observation one signed fact. Agents recall satellite, weather, elevation, soil and land-cover facts with Ed25519 receipts, cite them with tokens, and write their own signed notes. A second agent checks any fact, note or receipt offline, without trusting the first. Reads need no key.
